nodes.label: Switch
nodes.description:
The Switch node evaluates an input against multiple cases and executes the corresponding flow for the matching case(s). 

Learn more about the Switch node: [Docs](https://docs.buildship.com/core-nodes/switch)

executionType.description: If several conditions are met, choose whether you want to execute only the first matching case or all the matching cases.
executionType.title: Execution Type

condition_fallback.description:
The Output Node returns values from the flow and handles HTTP response codes.  
The default configuration is to return the previous node output. But you can specify any custom output to return variables from other nodes or JavaScript expressions. 

Learn more about the Output node: [Docs](https://docs.buildship.com/core-nodes/return)
condition_fallback.label: Output
